prompt: Composition: Aligned comparison rows, sticky labels, compact toolbar, no hero. Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Set headings in Bagnard and reading text in Cotham Sans; characterful display serif with understated body. Use Plum and Mint: page #FCF9FF, text #3D2346, accent #805099, secondary surface #CDF3DF, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 36px, line height 1.6, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
